claim.en: In 2017 Sportnet listed Pavol Garaj of Poprad's Body Gym as a European and world professional kickboxing champion (WKA, BMAF, WKN) who also took part in the GLORY organisation.
claim.sk: Sportnet v roku 2017 uviedol Pavla Garaja z popradského BODY gymu ako profesionálneho majstra Európy a sveta v kickboxe (WKA, BMAF, WKN) a účastníka organizácie GLORY.

findings.identity: Poprad kickboxer Pavol Garaj (Body Gym Poprad; 2012 Sportnet calls him a Poprad kickboxer); the candidate is a 40-year-old trainer from Poprad; moderate confidence.
findings.quote: Pavol Garaj – WKA Professional European Champion, BMAF Professional World Champion, WKN Professional World Champion a spolu s Tomášom Možným aj účastník najlepšej kickboxerskej organizácie sveta s názvom GLORY
